facts.text: Deborah and her husband used to play games together as a way to bond and create memories.

evidence.quote: Reminds me of when I used to play games with my husband. We'd take turns and it was a great way to bond and make memories.

facts.text: Deborah and her husband preferred to play detective games together.

evidence.quote: We prefer to play detective games together.

facts.text: Deborah and her husband also enjoyed spending time outdoors and exploring nature.

evidence.quote: We also enjoyed spending time outdoors and exploring nature. It was always so refreshing to be outside and soak up the fresh air.
